text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten, held at Oi
Racecourse, is a
major dirt race that
marks the year's end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is here that, once again, Copano
Rickey will
face off against Hokko
Tarumae and Wonder
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Tarumae is here. I wonder if I should say

something to her. I still have a little time
before
the race starts.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, she's leaving! Wait, where is she
going?!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (The Oi wharf? What's she doing there?)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I know you're there.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know you're there, Rickey. You can
come out
now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You noticed me?! Um... okay...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha... Sorry. I was just, um, curious.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was about to ask what you were doing
here.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The port...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Tomakomai has a port, just like Oi.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's no match for Tokyo Bay, of course.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The amount of freight handled here each
year is
on a whole other scale.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know because I asked one of the
higher-ups
from the Tomakomai harbor
office while I was
back home for a local
event.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I-is that so?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Two ports. Oi and Tomakomai. But one's
so much
more famous.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But there's a silver lining. They're both
connected,
you see.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
From Oi to Tomakomai. Which means, if
I do my
best...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe, just like the freight, I can deliver
a bit of
everyone's attention to my
home.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's what I think to myself whenever I
race here
at Oi.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So I won't lose. I can't. Because if I do, I
won't
send anything back.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not much, I'll take whatever I
can get.
My hometown deserves it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...That's what she said. She was really
intense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I both nod along as
Copano
Rickey tells us what happened.
It seems Hokko
Tarumae will be a
formidable opponent today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But, you know what, Rickey? You don't
need to
be afraid.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When you're racing, running's all that
matters.
And there isn't a racer out there
who won't give it
her all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That goes for you, Tarumae, and myself,
too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You're right. They might not be
doing it for
their hometown...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But it's the last big race of the year.
None of them
are going to hold back.
We all have a chance to
take the win!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I almost got caught up in
Tarumae's
feelings. But I'm not Tarumae.
I'm me! ☆
choice_data_list: そうだよ、飲まれないで

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! It's the final grand stage before
the
year's over! Today, I'm gonna show
everyone how
Copano Rickey runs!
